text: A song of ascents. 1 Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD {YHWH}!
O Lord {Adonai}, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord {Adonai}, could stand?
But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
I wait for the LORD {YHWH}; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
My soul waits for the Lord {Adonai} more than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.
O Israel (he wrestles with God), put your hope in the LORD {YHWH}, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
And He will redeem Israel (he wrestles with God) from all iniquity.
